question.text: Which of the following compounds will form the precipitate with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>aq</mi><mo>.</mo><mo> </mo><msub><mi>AgNO</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math> solution most readily?

solution.text:
It is an example of SN1 reaction.

Rate of SN1 reaction α stability of carbocation 

In option 1 carbocation formed after removing halogen is destabilized by -I effect.

In option 2 carbocation formed after removing halogen is stabilized by +M effect since lone pair is present at oxygen atom.

In option 3 carbocation formed after removing halogen is stabilized by +M effect of lone pair present on nitrogen atom but lone pair is also in conjugation with benzene ring therefore +M effect is less.

In option 4 carbocation formed after removing halogen is stabilized by +M effect of lone pair present on nitrogen atom and +M effect of nitrogen atom is more than that of oxygen atom. Hence, option 4 is most stable.
